name: video-embed
description: Embeds a YouTube or Vimeo video in a 16:9 responsive ratio with configurable controls.

videoUrl.title: Video URL
videoUrl.description: Enter a YouTube or Vimeo URL.

includeText.title: Include supporting text
includeText.description: When enabled, the supporting text field will be rendered alongside the video.

text.title: Supporting text
text.description: Optional text to display alongside the video. Only shown if Include supporting text is enabled.

textPosition.title: Text position
textPosition.description: Position of the text relative to the video.

showSuggestedVideos.title: Show suggested videos
showSuggestedVideos.description: Show suggested videos after playback ends (YouTube only).
